name: Be a Paper Airplane
desc:
✈️ How FAR can you FLY?

💡 How to play:
        💵 Become a paper airplane and fly to collect cash!
        🏢 Buy floors to build the tallest tower and fly farther!
        🚀 Upgrade paper airplanes to increase speed!
        😄 Teleport to friends’ towers and race!

👍 Like and favorite for more updates!
